speaker: Doctor
text: That sounds concerning. To narrow this down, can you tell me if your double vision goes away when you close one of your eyes?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those details; that pattern of worsening with activity and relief with rest is very specific. Given the eye movements and limb weakness, could you tell me if you ever experience drooping of your eyelids (ptosis) or difficulty swallowing? Also, do you have a history of myasthenia gravis or thyroid issues?

speaker: Patient
text: I have not had recent infections or fevers, and there is no family history of neurological disease. The weakness feels symmetrical in both arms and legs.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: Acetylcholine_receptor_antibodies, Anti-MuSK, Thyroid_function_tests, Electrodiagnostic_study (EMG/NCS).
DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis
